verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas is a first-party, in-product AI assistant. Users can ask it anything about their sales tax and get answers with the reasoning shown, grounded in their own transactions, registrations, filings and certificates, which directly delivers AI-generated insights from user data. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, and it does not show proactive AI suggestions. missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, detailed product docs on AI Atlas capabilities and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask it anything about your sales tax and get an answer with the reasoning shown, grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates.
